facts: The distance of the dairy farm from the main road and other livestock farms must be at least 1 kilometer.
A dairy farm requires access to potable water.
Dairy farm infrastructures include cattle barn and calf barn.
A cattle barn includes a feeding area, a watering area, and a resting area.
The roofing of a cattle barn should be at least 5-6 meters high to minimize ammonia build up inside the barn.
Flooring of a cattle barn must be slotted or have a rough surface to prevent split cows.
Proper dairy farm infrastructure includes designated housing facilities specifically for calves (calf barn).

questions.question: Is the following statement true or false? 'Cattle barn roofing should be at least 5-6 meters high primarily to prevent split cows.'

options.A: True, because high roofs provide structural stability to avoid cattle slipping.
options.B: False, because high roofing is designed to minimize ammonia build-up inside the barn.
options.C: True, because low roofs cause cows to panic and split their legs.
options.D: False, because high roofing is meant strictly to collect rainwater for potable water supply.
